div.p: Earliest Deadline First (EDF) is a favorable algorithm in the field of dynamic scheduling which plans the task scheduling during system running. The CPU utilization of EDF algorithm may achieve to one hundred percent. Although EDF has many excellent performances and is used broadly in actual embedded real-time systems, it has many shortages. In order to reduce the release time of EDF scheduling algorithm and to decrease scheduling spending, the Deoxyribonucleic acid Genetic Algorithm (DNA-GA) is used to optimize the preemptive EDF scheduling algorithm in off-line model. Simulation experiments are carried out to compare the performances. Compared with the scheduling spending before optimized, the scheduling spending after optimized was reduced dramatically and the real-time performance was improved.

div.head: INTRODUCTION
div.p: Real-time scheduling algorithm is one of the key points for the design and realization of embedded real-time system. It is also the important method that ensures time restriction and reliability of the real-time system. Real-time scheduling is an important and active research field.

Among the scheduling algorithms, RM (Rate Monotonic) and EDF (Earliest Deadline First) are two of classical scheduling algorithms. RM and EDF were used broad for real-time scheduling. RM is a good algorithm in the field of static scheduling. RM plans the task scheduling before system running, and it is easy to carry out. If the preconditions can be meeting, RM can schedule real-time task sets successfully. EDF is a good algorithm in the field of dynamic scheduling. It plans the task scheduling during system running. The CPU utilization of EDF algorithm can achieve to 100%. Although RM and EDF have many excellent performances and are used very broad in actual embedded real-time system, but we can not ignore their shortage in application [1][2][3][4][5].

In this paper, the release time of EDF scheduling algorithm was optimized off-line using DNA-GA. And then, the release time optimized was used for scheduling real-time task sets in real-time system. 978-1-4244-7388-5/10/$26.00 ©201O IEEE

div.p: In the ideal status, EDF algorithm is the optimal dynamic scheduling algorithm in real-time system. But, as it is shown in Katcher's experiment [6], in the real implementation of real-time system, the intended utilization rate of task processor is lower than what it is in the ideal status. In order to help developers modeling and evaluate their real-time operating system, Kettler, Katcher and Strosnider established a framework which can describe the real-time systems' implementation costs [7].

div.head: IV. SIMULATION EXPERIMENTS
div.p: We made a simulation experiment with Visual C++ 6.0 and got several conclusions. In the following sections, we will introduce the experiment in detail.
In the experiments, popsi ze=8; lchrom=40; maxgen=40; and maxruns= 1.
The corresponding relationship between binary codes and DNA codes is shown as follow: OO .... .. A; 01 .... .. C; 10 .... .. G; ll .... .. T.
Given crossover probability is 0.80; mutation probability is 0.08; and running time t=12ms.

The tasks set S includes 5 tasks whose periods T)=O.4ms, T2=0.6ms, T3=1.6ms, T4=2.0ms and Ts=4.0ms; and their worst executing time C)=O.2ms, C2=0.3ms, C3=1.0ms, C4=1.6ms and Cs=3.0ms. The scheduling maximum cost caused by preemptions in each generation can be shown as Table 1. The average scheduling time cost caused by preemptions after optimization is 909.883888 Jls.

The scheduling cost comparison between before optimization and after optimization is shown in Figure 2. In Figure 2, the polygonal line marked by • represents the scheduling preemption cost before optimization and its value is 950.4 fls ; while the polygonal line marked by • represents the scheduling preemption cost after optimization and its value is shown in Table 1; and the polygonal line marked by ... represents the average scheduling preemption cost after optimization and its value is 909.883888 fls .

From the experiment, we learned that the average scheduling preemption cost after optimization is lower than the scheduling preemption cost before optimization which proved that the optimized scheduling algorithm based on DNA-GA can improve the system's performance.

div.head: V. CONCLUSIONS
div.p: Since the preemptive EDF algorithm has several prerequisites, it simplified the discussions of the scheduling model. But it is also a limit to not only the theory research but also real applications of the scheduling algorithm. In this paper, the dynamic scheduling EDF algorithm was optimized based on DNA-GA in the state of star-up time which is not zero value. The scheduling cost caused by preemption was deduced and the real-time performance was improved a lot.
The optimized algorithm plays an important role in reducing the tasks' start-up time. If we increase the evolutional generations, the optimization effect will be better.
